input_cif.description: S3 URI of one annotated CIF, optionally gzip- or zstd-compressed.

model_bundle.description: S3 prefix containing the matching config.json and model.safetensors exported by RFD4-Proteina.

settings.description: S3 URI of generation settings JSON: seed, num_replicates, batch_size and Hydra overrides.

container_image.description: RFD4-Proteina Linux amd64 CUDA image in ECR, preferably pinned by digest.

num_shards.description: Number of GPU tasks splitting the requested replicates. Must not exceed num_replicates.

generation_cpus.description: CPUs requested per GPU task (default 8). For example, 4 retains the L40S GPU with a smaller CPU allocation.

generation_accelerator.description: Explicit GPU selection: nvidia-l40s (default, 48GB) or nvidia-l4 (24GB). Validate memory use for the longest input before choosing L4.
